title: Mixing: Mary Had A Little Lamb by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio Two, Island Studios, London
Producer: Glyn Johns
Engineers: Phil Ault

Wings’ second single, ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’, was mixed on 3 April 1972.

The mixing session took place at Island Studios in London, with Glyn Johns producing. This was his final time working with Paul McCartney, following a number of fractious recording sessions for Red Rose Speedway the previous month.

‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’ was released as a standalone single in May 1972.
